_comment: Connections from your searches (Guy, 27-28 Nov 2026 - docs/CONNECTIONS-SEARCH-BUILD-PLAN.md).
A client's search of their OWN 1st-degree connections is put at the head of this campaign by
lh-connection-search.py as Linked Helper's auto-collect step (the same one a top-up uses); this
recipe is the two steps behind it: visit the profile, send the person to the client's webhook.
NO invite, NO message - ever. That is the line Guy held: every first message is written by /wg
A visit and a send a day each, at most SEARCH_VISITS_PER_DAY (unset = 5, safe for a Standard licence -
its webhook allowance is 20 a day for the whole machine; Pro machines set 25) - the script writes that
number over maxActionResultsPerIteration before building. One iteration a day (20-hour cooldown),
05:00-07:30 machine time: after the 00:00 own-connections run and the 02:30 backup, done before
NOT part of the default build - lh-connection-search.py builds it the first time a search arrives.
name: Connections from your searches
description: Wingguy: your own connections from a search you sent. Visit, then send to Wingguy. No invite, no message.
